rng: numpy 2.3.5 PCG64DXSM SeedSequence; preserve raw coordinates
intervals: strict endpoint-excluded Alexandrov counts; probes not sprinkled elements
causal_precision: 64*machine_epsilon margin; long-double re-evaluation; unresolved=>GEOMETRY_HOLD; no redraw
fields: fields.py: common smooth cutoff, 6 polynomial jets and mass-1 waves k=(0,2,4,8)
primary_operator_probes: 21: t=(-.5,0,.5), spatial origin and six axis points at radius .5
detector_probes: 7: t=1, center=(0,0,1.5) and six axis offsets of .25; diagnostics, not detector integrals
operator_error: RMS over fixed 21 probes / max(RMS phi / L0^2,RMS exact Box phi); aggregate RMSE over independent realizations
G1_decision: diagnostic tolerance screen only; no confirmatory PASS without independent evidence and all adapters
propagation: retarded (B-m^2)phi=J with oracle history on all t<=-1; not an intrinsic Cauchy-source adapter
manufactured_controls: 4 mass-1 compact wave fields, exact analytic J=(Box-1)phi
compact_source_controls: parent-contract bump a=.5,k0=4,phi(-1)=f,dt phi(-1)=0, m=(0,1,2), homogeneous KG; numerical continuum history

reference.method: periodic Fourier multiplier cos(sqrt(k^2+m^2)*(t+1)); trilinear space and linear time interpolation
reference.status: resolution comparison only, no rigorous error remainder; REFERENCE_HOLD

solver_control: normalized algebraic backward residual; separate unit history response, mass=1, zero forcing; not a norm stability proof

boundary_extension.evaluation: operator only at all fixed probes

statistics: fixed M=16; descriptive mean bias, sample SD and RMSE; no optional stopping, no confirmatory confidence interval or power-law inference
failures: retain every run identity and status; any failed run gives overall HOLD; no conditional-success primary result
